arguments.text: Implemented evaluate(request, policy) in work.py. It validates rows in input order with one prioritized error (id, amount, unit, duplicate), defaults unit from policy, tracks only fully accepted IDs, normalizes amounts, clears all records on any error, and does not mutate inputs. Current report.json exactly matches evaluating requests.json under policy.json.

Boundary checks passed for duplicate handling, invalid bool/NaN/inf/negative amounts, unhashable unknown units, error priority, -0.0 acceptance, exact output fields, report regeneration, and input immutability. Limits: behavior assumes request has rows and policy has base_unit, units, unique as required by the task contract; malformed top-level API objects were not specified or tested.
